summary: Indianapolis ranks 31st in EPA per deep attempt, so the Colts must hit chunk plays against a Giants defense that ranks 2nd on those throws. Malik Nabers draws 29% of the Giants' targets, and he runs into an Indianapolis pass defense that ranks 26th. Our model has the Giants at 55%, well below the market's 71%, and the passing matchup supplies most of that lean.

NYG.detail: The Giants' defense ranks 7th in EPA per dropback (-0.01 allowed). Indianapolis ranks 27th (-0.06).
The Giants rank 32nd in broken tackles per touch (3.2%). Indianapolis' defense ranks 8th (10.7% missed).
The Giants rank 4th in pressure rate (21%). Indianapolis' defense ranks 18th (22% generated).

IND.detail: Indianapolis ranks 31st in EPA per deep attempt (+0.18). The Giants' defense ranks 2nd (+0.30 allowed).
Indianapolis' defense ranks 29th in explosive play rate (9.8% allowed). The Giants rank 24th (8.7%).
Indianapolis ranks 24th in EPA per dropback vs blitz (-0.03). The Giants' defense ranks 11th (+0.01 allowed).
